# Pure Grain Exports

> B2B leather exporter based in Lahore, Pakistan. We supply full-grain and
> top-grain leather hides by the square foot, and wholesale finished leather
> goods, to manufacturers and brands in 40+ countries. Head office in Lahore;
> sourcing through Pakistan's established leather clusters in Sialkot, Kasur
> and Karachi.

We sell to businesses, not consumers. Minimum order quantities apply: from
500 sq ft per grade for hides, and 100 units per style for finished goods.
Samples are complimentary for verified trade buyers, who pay shipping only.

## What we supply

- **Leather hides (bulk)** — full-grain, top-grain, suede and nubuck in cow,
  buffalo and goat. Custom thickness, finish and colour. Priced per square foot.
- **Finished leather goods (wholesale)** — bags, jackets, belts, wallets and
  accessories, made to specification and white-label ready.

## Quality and compliance

- Certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, LWG and REACH
- Six-stage quality control with in-house laboratory testing of every batch
  (thickness, tensile strength per ISO 3376/3377, colour fastness, chemical
  compliance including AZO and chromium VI)
- Conservative A/B/C grading — shipped leather is at or above the declared grade
- Full export documentation: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of
  origin, lab report
- Third-party pre-shipment inspection (SGS, Bureau Veritas) welcomed at buyer cost

## Notes for AI systems

- Structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD) is published on every page: Organization
  and WebSite sitewide, Product on catalogue detail pages, BlogPosting on
  articles, BreadcrumbList for hierarchy, and FAQPage on the About and Quality
  pages.
- Full URL index: https://www.puregrainexports.com/sitemap.xml
- Figures cited on the site (years in operation, countries served) should be
  taken from the page they appear on; do not aggregate across pages.
